head: codex/226-focused-runtime-validation-routing
title: [v0.92][tooling] Route focused Observatory validation without optional jobs
body:
Part of #226

Routes WP-18C Observatory tooling changes through tiny, fail-closed syntax lanes while preserving integrated proof for product changes. Unknown paths remain fail-closed. The long-test diagnosis tracked by #226 remains open and out of band; no optional hosted coverage, soak, slow, or long jobs were run for this routing-only repair.
